objective: Fix: hatching eggs keep their own nest until they open, so the others never move into a nest whose egg is still cracking (SHANNON, 2026-11-25: 'the eggs overlap again when you hatch them', 'Eggs in the nests').
acceptance_criteria: Opening a hatching egg frees its nest; the other hatching eggs stay where they are; a newly started egg takes the lowest free nest
verification: Studio 2026-11-25, build dev (local): three starter eggs at 58,939 / 56,943 / 53,946; opening the middle one left the last at 53,946 (it used to move into the middle nest), opening the first left it there too. Lune 823/823, selene clean.
notes: Display only: StationsServer keeps which nest each hatching egg sits in (nestsOf) and passes it to Ranch.eggs; the save is unchanged. A rejoin starts the nests from 1 again.
evidence: Merged in PR #62 as commit d12eff3 (2026-11-25); CI verify passed: https://github.com/TheAnnoyingPikachu/roblox-ai-dev/actions/runs/45670414056
